name: Camp CaPella – Weekly Overnight Camp
description_short: A small overnight camp in Dedham, Maine. Campers arrive Sunday afternoon and stay until Friday, and each week is set aside for one age group. Campers of all abilities are welcome, and the day campers join them for traditional camp activities.
special_needs_notes: Each week welcomes campers of all abilities and the camp stresses inclusion. Special diets will be accommodated where possible, and families may send their own food. Applicants must meet the eligibility policy in the application. Contact the office if you're unsure whether the camp is a good fit.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: No season year is tied to the price or program. The site's menu shows '2026 Summer Camp' and the copyright says 2026, so this information may be from the 2026 season, which is already over, not 2027.
$2000 is the stated full cost per week. Families are asked to pay what they can: 'The average camper share is $500', and the camp says 'no one is turned away based on ability to pay'.
Age 8+ is described as 'most ideal', not a strict minimum. The camp also prefers that campers have done at least one week of day camp first.
Space is limited. Campers who can't be accepted are put on a wait list.
